home.heroDescription: Founded in memory of Mesfin Hiruy, we provide healthcare support, education, and play for children in need. Because every child deserves a chance to heal, learn, and smile.
home.missionBody1: Mesfin Hiruy was born on 7 December 1990. Since the age of two, he bravely fought off Leukaemia. His mother, Nebiat Yoseph, founded this charity in his memory to help children in Eritrea who suffer from various illnesses.
home.missionBody2: We believe that sick children not only need medical and hospital care, but also need play, education, and moments of joy to make their lives a little more bearable.
home.ctaDescription: Whether you donate, volunteer, or simply spread the word, your support changes lives. Join us in supporting sick children in Eritrea.

about.pageSubtitle: Founded in memory of Mesfin Hiruy, a brave young boy who inspired a movement of compassion.
about.originBody1: Mesfin Hiruy was born on 7 December 1990. Since the age of two, he bravely fought off Leukaemia (a blood cancer). Until his final hours of his life he had endured untold pain and sufferings. Mesfin passed away on 4 October 2000.
about.originBody2: His mother, Nebiat Yoseph, decided to help the children in Eritrea who suffer from various forms of illnesses. Together with her and Mesfin's friends, and well wishers, she is founding the charity in memory of her dearly loved and only child.
about.quote1: Sick children not only need medical and hospital care, but also need a diversion from the daily suffering and pain.
about.quote2: Playing and game tools makes them feel happy and makes their life a little bit more bearable.
about.quote3: In addition to appropriate medical treatment, education and fun plays a crucial part in their healing process.
about.quote4: Such a noble initiative can only succeed with the support from individuals, businesses and organisations.
about.missionSubtitle: The three charitable objects that guide everything we do.
about.healthDesc: To promote the physical and mental well being of children in need and sick children in Eritrea.
about.educationDesc: To promote the education of target group by providing equipment and facilities.
about.reliefDesc: Relief of poverty of target group.
about.governanceBody: Mesfney Love Foundation is governed by a committee of trustees, elected annually by members at the AGM. The charity was formally established with the adoption of its constitution on 4 July 2008 and is registered with the Charity Commission under number 1139089.
